props.name: disabled
props._description: Blocks the whole search panel — no field can be edited and the search cannot be run.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.
